description: FULL in-context playbook. Signing starts with "do you have the key?" Step 1 key recovery (complete BIP39, missing word, passphrase, keystore v3, 2014-15 Ethereum presale, Electrum, wallet.dat, blockchain.info, hardware, raw key, password-hints) with reference code the human runs LOCALLY OFFLINE; only PUBLIC addresses leave the machine. Step 2 verify_tx. Step 3 human sign-off on EVERY tx and sign in their own wallet. Step 4 broadcast_tx. Pass situation to get one branch, or situation=full (default) for everything. Never ask the user to paste a seed or key into chat. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

situation.description: Recovery branch: full | seed-phrase | missing-word | passphrase | keystore | presale | electrum | wallet-dat | blockchain-info | hardware | raw-key | password-hints. Default full returns every branch in-context.
